_about: Explain with an AI. Providers are listed alphabetically; none is preferred. The offline derivation is always shown first, and a local model keeps everything on the machine. Vendor names live only in this file.
prompt_intro: Explain this jyotiṣa result step by step. Say which parts are astronomy, which are traditional rule, and where schools differ. Result and derivation follow.
copy_note: This provider does not accept a question in its address, so the question is copied for pasting.

basis.note: Chakra already opened claude.ai, chatgpt.com and perplexity.ai with the question in the address; the other address forms are not verified here and fall back to copying if they do not prefill.
